_comment: DK CAD Mobile release manifest. Lives in the dk_cad Pages repo ROOT as mobile-update.json; the app reads it from https://dheerajkum7g7-eng.github.io/dk_cad/mobile-update.json with the raw.githubusercontent copy as a mirror. The APK is stored as 2 MB PARTS because the publishing network's proxy rejects large authenticated uploads; GitHub does not join them, mobile.html does. To ship a new build: run publish-mobile.ps1, which rewrites version/size/sha256/partCount here. Keep this file SEPARATE from the desktop's update.json.
_urlNote: The SAME release asset the Google Sites download button points at, so there is one download in the world, not two. Release MV / DKCadMobile.apk is replaced in place on every version - the website link never changes. mobile.html on Pages is a BACKUP route for networks where github.com is blocked (this office's own laptops get 403 there).
notes: A new UTM tool: tap anywhere on the drawing and each point is numbered on screen and listed underneath with its Easting/Northing AND its latitude and longitude. Copy All puts the whole list on the clipboard - it pastes into Excel as columns, reads fine in WhatsApp, and the lat/long lines paste straight into Google Earth. Snapping now reaches INSIDE blocks: endpoints, midpoints, intersections and nodes of the lines within a block symbol can be picked at last, and a new INS button snaps to the insertion point of text and MText. The coordinate and distance labels are fixed-size again - they no longer grow with the zoom until one reading covers the drawing - and they stay beside the point you tapped instead of being pushed into a corner. The toolbar is rebuilt in three slim rows: global actions on top, all the drawing tools in their own scrolling row (one button each, no menu), then the snap toggles - which leaves noticeably more of the screen for the drawing.
